Or manual memo:

```python
def fib_memo(n, memo={}):
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n < 2:
        return n
    memo[n] = fib_memo(n-1, memo) + fib_memo(n-2, memo)
    return memo[n]
```

**Recursion** is a programming technique where a function calls itself to solve a problem by breaking it into smaller, self‑similar sub‑problems. The classic example is the Fibonacci sequence:

\[
\text{fib}(n) = 
\begin{cases}
0 & n = 0\\
1 & n = 1\\
\text{fib}(n-1) + \text{fib}(n-2) & n > 1
\end{cases}
\]
